archetypes.name: dyn-run-log-validator
archetypes.rationale: Validate the new check-only run-log CLI behavior and quiet-mode routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new run-log validate-run-id entrypoint and dispatcher wiring. Focus on exit-code behavior, exact VALID=true/false stdout, argparse handling for empty and dash-leading values, and whether quiet-mode suppression can affect the guard. Check that tests cover both helper and dispatcher contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
